subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Fazer uso consciente e reflexivo de regras e normas da norma-padrão em situações de fala e escrita nas quais ela deve ser usada.

components.description_pt: Identificar quando um contexto ou tarefa requer o uso do inglês formal
components.description_en: Identify when a context or task requires the use of formal English
components.cc_component_description: Identify when a context or task requires the use of formal English

components.description_pt: Aplicar convenções de gramática padrão do inglês com precisão na escrita formal
components.description_en: Apply standard English grammar conventions accurately in formal writing
components.cc_component_description: Apply standard English grammar conventions accurately in formal writing

components.description_pt: Aplicar convenções de inglês formal ao falar em contextos que o exigem
components.description_en: Apply formal English conventions when speaking in contexts that require them
components.cc_component_description: Apply formal English conventions when speaking in contexts that require them

components.description_pt: Refletir sobre as razões sociais e comunicativas de usar a norma padrão em contextos específicos
components.description_en: Reflect on the social and communicative reasons for using the standard norm in specific contexts
components.cc_component_description: Adapt writing style to suit a specific audience and communicative purpose

cc_matches.description: Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and tasks, demonstrating command of formal English when indicated or appropriate.
Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.
Adapt speech to a variety of contexts and communicative tasks, demonstrating command of formal English when indicated or appropriate.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
